Problem Description

Troubleshooting
: Hello Eduard,
First and foremost, we would like to extend our sincerest apologies for the delay in processing your case. We completely understand how frustrating this situation must be for you, and we deeply regret any inconvenience this has caused. Unfortunately, due to a glitch in our system, we needed to recreate your case, which has taken longer than anticipated.
After carefully reviewing the logs on our backend, we found that the system is showing as offline, and it appears that the configuration file has become corrupted. We truly understand the importance of resolving this quickly, but due to the nature of the issue, we are unable to access the system remotely via SSH.
To ensure that we can resolve this as efficiently as possible, we are arranging for a visit from our regional country team. They will reach out to you shortly to schedule the visit and provide the necessary assistance in person.
We fully appreciate your patience and understanding throughout this process, and once again, we deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused. Please rest assured that we are doing everything we can to resolve this promptly.
Thank you for your continued trust in us.
For future reference, your case number is
0411694
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vaishnavy Gurav

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411694-DC/Si-D/DE [MP / RD 170003105] Charger Offline CRM:01282000861
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I hope this email finds you well.
I am writing to inform you that we’ve encountered an issue with this charger, the configuration file appears to be corrupted, resulting in the system going offline. After assessment, we’ve determined that flashing the CFast card with new configurations is the necessary resolution.
Could you please let me know when you plan to schedule the site visit to carry out this task in advance if you require intervention support from our side.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav
